author: Haibo Tong
task_instruction:
You are my workflow agent. I am Tom (email: tom.harrison@acme.ai), Customer Support Manager.

We have an escalated support ticket from our biggest client MegaCorp - their integration has been down for 6 hours and they're threatening to escalate to their CEO. The ticket is CS-258 and it's marked P1 critical. We need to mobilize the right people and communicate clearly.

Here's the escalation workflow:
1) Check my Gmail for the escalation notice about CS-258 with the technical details.
2) Create a Jira task "CS-258 CRITICAL: MegaCorp Integration Outage" and tag it as P1 blocker.
3) Post to Slack #support-escalations alerting the team about the critical issue and asking for immediate help.
4) Schedule a Zoom war room "CS-258 MegaCorp War Room" starting in 15 minutes for real-time coordination.
5) Add a Calendar event for the war room and invite the on-call engineer, support lead, and account manager.
6) Send an email to the MegaCorp contact (john.smith@megacorp.com) acknowledging the issue and providing war room dial-in.
7) Create a Google Form "CS-258 Incident Timeline" to track all actions taken during resolution.
8) Post an update to Slack #customer-success alerting the account team about the escalation.

MegaCorp is a $5M ARR account - this needs immediate attention.
agent_system_prompt: You are a helpful workflow automation assistant. Complete all assigned tasks efficiently using available tools.
